notes: Nonlinear periodic Rusanov propagation; seed 4901, CFL 0.25. Wall times include conversion and Metal process/IO startup. Memory is MiB; Metal child ru_maxrss is a cumulative high-water mark, so its delta can be zero after warm-up and is not an individual child peak. MLX RSS is the cumulative process high-water mark. Relative differences are maximum errors normalized by each reference component's maximum.
